answer: Locks are recorded in pigment, expire in crystal, and reef lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 51 aliases therefore needs 170 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3504 identities would post 624 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
